description: This file defines the MiniKeyboardKeyDetector class, which extends KeyDetector and is responsible for detecting keys and nearby keys on a mini keyboard layout within the AnySoftKeyboard project. It includes logic for calculating the closest key based on touch coordinates and whether keys are shifted.

classes.name: MiniKeyboardKeyDetector
classes.description: A class that detects key presses and nearby keys on a mini keyboard layout, considering slide allowances and shift states.

methods.name: MiniKeyboardKeyDetector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes slide allowances based on the provided slide allowance value.

methods.name: getMaxNearbyKeys
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of nearby keys to consider, which is 1.

methods.name: getKeyIndexAndNearbyCodes
methods.description: Determines the index of the closest key to the touch point and optionally fills an array with the key code.

methods.name: isKeyShifted
methods.description: Checks if a given key is shifted based on the keyboard's shift state.
